event_name: Date 14 November 2021 Time 14:35 2021 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 11 - 14 November 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 2 (d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that TSU caused a collision with car 18 (STR). Car 22 was slipstreaming car 18 along the front straight and was considerably faster on the inside at turn 1. However, he braked too late and collided with car 18 in this optimistic manoeuvre. The Stewards find him wholly at fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 22 Collision With Car 18
